headline_marked: Tk 7,000 crore [[//s embezzled from teachers' funds]] by previous govt, says Education Minister
headline: Tk 7,000 crore //s embezzled from teachers' funds by previous govt, says Education Minister
summary: Education Minister A N M Ehsanul Haq Millon says 65,000 retired teachers have been deprived of their benefits since 2022.
details: Education Minister A N M Ehsanul Haq Millon revealed that approximately Tk 7,000 crore was embezzled from the Ministry of Education's welfare trust and festival allowance fund during the previous government's tenure.
As a result, around 65,000 retired teachers have been deprived of their rightful financial benefits since 2022.
The Minister stated that payments of at least Tk 1 lakh each will begin by the end of July this year, with all remaining arrears are to be paid gradually.
Highlighting the government's priority for education, he mentioned that the current budget allocation of Tk 1.36 lakh crore is the highest in the country's history.
The government plans to increase the education budget to 5% of the GDP in the future and is taking steps to gradually increase the festival allowance for teachers from 50% to 100%.
These remarks were made during the inauguration of the Bisweswar Poddar building at Panchmighat High School in Sonargaon, Narayanganj.
caption:
Tk 7,000 crore stolen from teachers' funds? 65,000 retired teachers left without their benefits.

Education Minister A N M Ehsanul Haq Millon revealed that approximately Tk 7,000 crore was embezzled from the Ministry of Education's welfare trust and festival allowance fund during the previous government's tenure.

As a result, around 65,000 retired teachers have been deprived of their rightful financial benefits since 2022.

The Minister stated that payments of at least Tk 1 lakh each will begin by the end of July this year, with all remaining arrears are to be paid gradually.

Highlighting the government's priority for education, he mentioned that the current budget allocation of Tk 1.36 lakh crore is the highest in the country's history.

The government plans to increase the education budget to 5% of the GDP in the future and is taking steps to gradually increase the festival allowance for teachers from 50% to 100%.

These remarks were made during the inauguration of the Bisweswar Poddar building at Panchmighat High School in Sonargaon, Narayanganj.

#Bangladesh #Education #Corruption #Teachers #News

Source: Jamuna TV, Somoy News
